title: IndicRAG-QA Regulatory Condition & Relationship Schema
description: Formal schema for regulatory conditions, relationships, temporal scopes, and controller decision metadata in IndicRAG-QA

descriptions.COURSE_GRADING: Course-level evaluation, minimum lecture/tutorial/practical attendance profile, grade penalty (e.g. 'X' grade), and course repetition requirements. Enforced by Course Instructor and School Dean.
descriptions.EXAM_ELIGIBILITY: Institutional university-wide requirements to sit for End Semester Examinations and admit card issuance under statutory authority (e.g. UGC Regulations). Enforced by Registrar and Controller of Examination.
descriptions.MEDICAL_CONDONATION: Formal attendance relaxation or condonation ceiling granted for continuous illness or university deputation upon certified evidence.
descriptions.DISCIPLINARY_ACTION: Proctorial guidelines, campus conduct, hostel rules, and examination hall malpractice (UFM) codes.
descriptions.ACADEMIC_PROGRESSION: Minimum CGPA/SGPA thresholds, credit accumulation requirements for semester promotion, academic probation, and maximum degree duration.
descriptions.PROGRAMME_REQUIREMENT: School- or branch-specific curriculum structure, core/elective distribution, and branch migration criteria.
descriptions.OTHER: Administrative notices, general fee policies, and academic calendar operational dates.

descriptions.SAME_CONDITION_AGREEMENT: Current and historical regulations specify identical numerical thresholds and consequences for the same condition. Yields SUFFICIENT evidence with zero conflict.
descriptions.SAME_CONDITION_DIFFERENT_VERSION: Successive versions modify the rule for the exact same condition. Requires temporal/cohort anchoring or clarification.
descriptions.DIFFERENT_REGULATORY_CONDITIONS: Retrieved passages govern distinct operational stages, authorities, or scopes (e.g. 70% course grading vs 75% exam hall). Yields multi-condition disclosure without contradiction.
descriptions.EXPLICITLY_SUPERSEDES: Newer legal instrument contains express repeal or supersession clause. Older clause is legally invalidated.
descriptions.PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC_RULE: School-level rule operates within statutory boundaries delegated by university-wide ordinance.
descriptions.HISTORICAL_RULE: Document applies exclusively to past cohorts. Valid when queried with historical anchor; otherwise de-emphasized.
descriptions.APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED: Document scope cannot be definitively assigned to query cohort/program. Requires clarification or safe abstention.
descriptions.GENUINE_CONFLICT: Two legally co-equal, currently active rules within the same jurisdiction specify contradictory mandates for the same cohort.

academic_year_scope.description: Cohort or academic year span (e.g. '2017-18 to 2021-22', '2022-23 onwards')

canonical_thresholds.SCSET_UG_2022: 70% in course lectures, tutorials, practicals combined
canonical_thresholds.SEAS_UG_2017: 70% in course lectures, tutorials, practicals combined

COURSE_GRADING.canonical_consequence: Award of 'X' grade; course debarment and mandatory course repetition
required_evidence: Clause mentioning minimum course attendance or 'X' grade

inter_condition_relationship.EXAM_ELIGIBILITY: COMPLEMENTARY_PREREQUISITE (Course attendance feeds into overall eligibility; lower than exam hall threshold)
inter_condition_relationship.MEDICAL_CONDONATION: SUBJECT_TO_CONDONATION (Permits up to 10% relaxation down to 60%)

EXAM_ELIGIBILITY.canonical_consequence: Debarment from End Semester Examination; withholding of Examination Admit Card
required_evidence: Official notification or ordinance clause governing End Semester Exam eligibility

inter_condition_relationship.COURSE_GRADING: INSTITUTIONAL_OVERRIDE (Applies at university exam hall level across all registered courses)

canonical_thresholds.SCSET_UG_2022: Up to 10% relaxation (floor 60%) for >= 2 weeks illness
canonical_thresholds.SEAS_UG_2017: Up to 10% relaxation (floor 60%) for >= 2 weeks illness

MEDICAL_CONDONATION.canonical_consequence: Restoration of examination and grading eligibility
MEDICAL_CONDONATION.jurisdiction: Dean / Medical Board / Authorized University Committee
required_evidence: Explicit medical relaxation or condonation clause with required documentation

inter_condition_relationship.EXAM_ELIGIBILITY: MITIGATING_EXCEPTION (Condonation ceiling applied to attendance shortage)

DISCIPLINARY_ACTION.canonical_consequence: Proctorial warning, fine, suspension, expulsion, or UFM examination cancellation
DISCIPLINARY_ACTION.jurisdiction: Proctorial Board / Examination Disciplinary Committee / Vice Chancellor
required_evidence: Discipline code clause or UFM penalty table category

inter_condition_relationship.EXAM_ELIGIBILITY: DISQUALIFYING (UFM or disciplinary suspension cancels exam eligibility)

ACADEMIC_PROGRESSION.canonical_consequence: Promotion to higher semester, academic probation, or degree termination
required_evidence: Credit accumulation rules, minimum CGPA tables, or progression clauses

inter_condition_relationship.COURSE_GRADING: DEPENDENT (Earned credits depend on clearing courses without 'F' or 'X' grades)

PROGRAMME_REQUIREMENT.canonical_consequence: Degree completion verification, branch transfer eligibility
PROGRAMME_REQUIREMENT.jurisdiction: School Academic Committee / Head of Department
required_evidence: Branch transfer criteria, credit distribution matrices
